authorisation: User decisions 2026-11-12: NPIPE/PR4 excluded; re-fit approved; unblinded count-dipole computation on Quaia, NVSS and RACS-low approved ('both steps', after the offer 'if you approve the unblinding').

operator.note: system numexpr/bottleneck emitted NumPy-ABI warnings on import; the run completed and the numbers were identical across executions

estimator: Poisson-WLS pixel dipole validated on mocks (L2 pilot/NVSS/RACS slices); ICRS frame; Quaia expectation = official selection function T (variant: random density); NVSS/RACS expectation = SYNTHETIC uniform randoms in the cuts
preregistered_rule: Quaia baseline |b|>30 deg declared BEFORE the sweep was inspected (the first run, without latitude cuts, had been seen); per-axis max deviation across |b| cuts {0,10,20,30} and both expectations added in quadrature to the covariance. NVSS/RACS z-variance set to the declared (0.05)^2 because n_z = sin(dec) is degenerate with declination-dependent completeness.
posthoc_judgement: RACS excluded from the primary likelihood after seeing amplitude 0.068 (~4.5x other tracers); a sensitivity run with RACS included is provided.

legacy_values_for_comparison.note: legacy values in the likelihood module/COUNT_DIPOLE_RESULT.json, interpreted in their own galactic (l,b)

findings: Quaia amplitude depends strongly on the Galactic-latitude mask: G<20: 0.029 (no cut) -> 0.0148 (|b|>30); G<20.5: 0.036 -> 0.019. The legacy values (G20 0.0245, G20.5 0.0212, both unverified) do not correspond to the baseline rule.
Per-axis uncertainty at the baseline is dominated by the mask/expectation systematic (y-axis ~0.016-0.017), far above the Poisson error (~0.002).
NVSS amplitude 0.0116 (legacy 0.015 round numbers); RACS amplitude 0.068 is systematics-dominated (unmodelled tile rms/declination completeness).
The count-dipole excess seen with the legacy blocks is NOT reproduced with sourced, masked values: see REFIT_RECEIPT.json (v5).

claims.claim: Count dipoles for Quaia G<20, G<20.5 and NVSS were computed on the real catalogues with one estimator; RACS computed but not used.
claims.limit: mask systematics dominate; synthetic randoms for radio; no extinction/rms systematics model; selection-function T trusted

claims.claim: Kinematic dipole detected or excess over kinematic expectation established.
